package rulefixtures

import (
	"fmt"
	"net/http"
)

// scenario for package_level_mutable_config_used_by_handlers_services: Mutable package globals used as live config in request paths.
// fixture polarity: positive; family: architecture; severity: info.
type Config struct {
	MaxRetries int
	BaseURL    string
}

var Settings = Config{
	MaxRetries: 3,
	BaseURL:    "https://api.example.com",
}

func UpdateConfigHandler(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	Settings.MaxRetries = 5
	Settings.BaseURL = r.URL.Query().Get("base_url")
	fmt.Fprintf(w, "config updated")
}

func ServeRequest(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	client := &http.Client{}
	for i := 0; i < Settings.MaxRetries; i++ {
		resp, err := client.Get(Settings.BaseURL + "/data")
		if err == nil {
			fmt.Fprintf(w, "status: %d", resp.StatusCode)
			return
		}
	}
	http.Error(w, "all retries exhausted", http.StatusServiceUnavailable)
}
